page.overview:
What is Alexandra?

The Alexandra is a non-canon Marine ship which Drake used during his appearance in the 4th One Piece movie.

The Alexandra has a similar design to most Marine vessels. It has a green hull with brown lining. It also has an individualistic brown railing not commonly found on Marine vessels. It has two large masts and one smaller that have a total of five sails. In its interior, it has a technically advanced communications room.

The Alexandra was used by Drake when he was chasing the Straw Hat Pirates. It made a reappearance when Drake was shown at G-8 at the end of the Dead End Race.
